description: Find Romanian companies by the name of a director or legal representative (ONRC). Diacritic-insensitive. Whole words: 'pop maria' finds POP MARIA, not POPA MARIANA; prefix=true matches prefixes. The registry has no personal ID, so one name can be several people: homonyms and byCounty say so. Use this when you know a person rather than a firm.

compact.description: Optional: true keeps a short preset per row (name, CUI, county, city, legal form, risk level, phone, website, latest revenue and headcount).
compact.title: Compact

fields.description: Optional: keep only these company fields in each row, comma-separated (companyName,cui,county,risk; dotted paths such as risk.level work). Without it the full record is returned.
fields.title: Fields

name: lookup_director
